skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop vocabulary and reading/writing skills at B1 and B1+ level according to the European Framework, equivalent to IELTS 5.0-5.5.
Ability to skim and scan texts, identify main ideas, and infer meanings.
Ability to write academic paragraphs, essays, and summaries.
Ability to work in groups and pairs, and participate in discussions.
Ability to self-assess and improve reading and writing skills independently.
Ability to analyze and evaluate information, and form logical arguments.
